reproduced.C3_note: RefSeq NC_000908.2 currently annotates 504 intact CDS + 20 pseudogenes = 524 total CDS features. Fraser 1995 counted ~470 ORFs by then-current gene-finding; reannotations over 30 years converged near 475-525.
reproduced.C7_smallest_self_replicating_genome_1995: Historical/contextual: True in 1995 (H. influenzae Rd was 1.83 Mb, M. genitalium at 0.58 Mb was the smallest known self-replicating genome). Later surpassed by Carsonella ruddii (~160 kb, 2006) which is an endosymbiont, and by JCVI-syn3.0 (~531 kb, 2016) which is synthetic. Contextual claim upheld at time of publication.

C3_protein_coding_genes.type: quantitative (Fraser 1995 originally called 470 ORFs; range 470-480 across follow-up analyses)

C7_smallest_self_replicating_genome_1995.type: historical claim (smallest known genome of a self-replicating organism at time of publication)
